# sigma_grant (Resource)

Manages a generic Sigma inode grant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sigma_grant" "example" {
  inode_id   = sigma_file.example.id
  member_id  = "member-id"
  permission = "view"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `inode_id` (String) Inode ID.
- `permission` (String) Permission allowed by the inode type: `admin`, `annotate`, `update`, `usage`, `writeback`, `create`, `organize`, `explore`, `view`, `edit`, or `apply`.

### Optional

- `member_id` (String) Member ID receiving the grant. Exactly one of `member_id` or `team_id` must be set.
- `tag_id` (String) Optional version tag ID. Supported by generic, workbook, and report grants. Changing this forces a new resource. Tagged workbook/report grants are created through the generic grants API so Terraform receives a stable grant ID.
- `team_id` (String) Team ID receiving the grant. Exactly one of `member_id` or `team_id` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Grant creation timestamp.
- `created_by` (String) ID of the member who created the grant.
- `id` (String) Grant ID.
- `inode_type` (String) Inode type.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Grant update timestamp.
- `updated_by` (String) ID of the member who last updated the grant.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sigma_grant.example grant-id
```
